verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API reference at docs.segmentapis.com is described as an interactive reference with a downloadable OpenAPI spec and sections for 'Create a test request' and 'Install and use an SDK'. It also covers authentication, rate limits, pagination and versioning, so the core of an explorable API reference is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of in-browser runnable/try-it request execution beyond a section title, per-endpoint runnable examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
